title: त्रिसप्तत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 273 · Indra and the sin of killing a brahmin

summary.en: Bhishma tells of the signs of the fever that seized Vritra and of how Indra slew him with his thunderbolt, only to be pursued by the sin of killing a brahmin. Brahma drives the sin from Indra by dividing it among fire, plants, trees, water, women and others who each take a part.
summary.kn: ವೃತ್ರನನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದ ಜ್ವರದ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನೂ ಇಂದ್ರ ವಜ್ರದಿಂದ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕೊಂದು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಹತ್ಯೆಯ ಪಾಪ ಬೆನ್ನಟ್ಟಿದುದನ್ನೂ ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಆ ಪಾಪವನ್ನು ಅಗ್ನಿ, ಸಸ್ಯ, ಮರ, ನೀರು, ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರು ಮೊದಲಾದವರಿಗೆ ಹಂಚಿ ಇಂದ್ರನಿಂದ ಹೊರಹಾಕುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म वृत्र को जकड़ने वाले ज्वर के लक्षण और इन्द्र द्वारा वज्र से उसके वध और फिर ब्रह्महत्या के पाप के पीछे लगने की कथा कहते हैं। ब्रह्मा उस पाप को अग्नि, ओषधि, वृक्ष, जल, स्त्रियों आदि में बाँटकर इन्द्र से दूर करते हैं।
summary.te: వృత్రుని పట్టిన జ్వర లక్షణాలను, ఇంద్రుడు వజ్రంతో అతన్ని చంపి బ్రహ్మహత్య పాపం వెంటాడిన కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. బ్రహ్మ ఆ పాపాన్ని అగ్ని, ఓషధులు, చెట్లు, నీరు, స్త్రీలు మొదలైనవారికి పంచి ఇంద్రుని నుండి తొలగిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: வித்ரனைப் பற்றிய காய்ச்சலின் அறிகுறிகளையும் இந்திரன் வஜ்ரத்தால் அவனைக் கொன்று பிரம்மஹத்தி பாவம் பின்தொடர்ந்ததையும் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். பிரம்மன் அப்பாவத்தை நெருப்பு, செடிகள், மரங்கள், நீர், பெண்கள் முதலியோருக்குப் பகிர்ந்து இந்திரனிடமிருந்து நீக்குகிறான்.
summary.ml: വൃത്രനെ പിടികൂടിയ ജ്വരത്തിന്റെ ലക്ഷണങ്ങളും, ഇന്ദ്രൻ വജ്രായുധത്താൽ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ വധിച്ചതും, തുടർന്ന് ബ്രാഹ്മണഹത്യയുടെ പാപം ഇന്ദ്രനെ പിന്തുടർന്നതും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. ആ പാപം അഗ്നി, സസ്യങ്ങൾ, മരങ്ങൾ, ജലം, സ്ത്രീകൾ എന്നിവർക്കിടയിൽ വിഭജിച്ച് ബ്രഹ്മാവ് ഇന്ദ്രനിൽനിന്ന് അകറ്റുന്നു; ഓരോരുത്തരും ഓരോ ഭാഗം ഏറ്റെടുക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.273; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
वृत्रस्य तु महाराज ज्वराविष्टस्य सर्वशः ।
अभवन्यानि लिङ्गानि शरीरे तानि मे शृणु ॥

meaning.en: Great king, hear from me the signs that appeared in the body of Vritra, seized by fever on all sides.

verses.text:
ज्वलितास्योऽभवद्घोरो वैवर्ण्यं चागमत्परम् ।
गात्रकम्पश्च सुमहाञ्श्वासश्चाप्यभवन्महान् ।
रोमहर्षश्च तीव्रोऽभून्निःश्वासश्च महान्नृप ॥

meaning.en: His mouth blazed, he became terrible, his color turned very pale, great trembling came to his limbs, he breathed heavily, his hair stood on end sharply, and he sighed greatly, king.

verses.text:
शिवा चाशिवसंकाशा तस्य वक्त्रात्सुदारुणा ।
निष्पपात महाघोरा स्मृतिः सा तस्य भारत ।
उल्काश्च ज्वलितास्तस्य दीप्ताः पार्श्वे प्रपेदिरे ॥

meaning.en: A jackal, fearful and inauspicious-looking, came dreadfully out of his mouth; so too, Bharata, that memory of his. Blazing meteors fell burning at his side.

verses.text:
गृध्रकङ्कवडाश्चैव वाचोऽमुञ्चन्सुदारुणाः ।
वृत्रस्योपरि संहृष्टाश्चक्रवत्परिबभ्रमुः ॥

meaning.en: Vultures, herons and crows, giving out dreadful cries, circled over Vritra in delight, like a wheel.

verses.text:
ततस्तं रथमास्थाय देवाप्यायितमाहवे ।
वज्रोद्यतकरः शक्रस्तं दैत्यं प्रत्यवैक्षत ॥

meaning.en: Then Shakra, strengthened by the gods, mounted his chariot in the battle and, thunderbolt raised in hand, looked at that Daitya.

verses.text:
अमानुषमथो नादं स मुमोच महासुरः ।
व्यजृम्भत च राजेन्द्र तीव्रज्वरसमन्वितः ।
अथास्य जृम्भतः शक्रस्ततो वज्रमवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the great asura let out an inhuman cry; and, king, he yawned, joined with the fierce fever. As he yawned, Shakra hurled the thunderbolt.

verses.text:
स वज्रः सुमहातेजाः कालाग्निसदृशोपमः ।
क्षिप्रमेव महाकायं वृत्रं दैत्यमपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: That thunderbolt, of great radiance, like the fire of time, quickly felled the huge-bodied Daitya Vritra.

verses.text:
ततो नादः समभवत्पुनरेव समन्ततः ।
वृत्रं विनिहतं दृष्ट्वा देवानां भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then a shout arose again on all sides, seeing Vritra killed, among the gods, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
वृत्रं तु हत्वा भगवान्दानवारिर्महायशाः ।
वज्रेण विष्णुयुक्तेन दिवमेव समाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed Vritra with the thunderbolt joined with Vishnu, the blessed, greatly famed enemy of the Danavas entered heaven.

verses.text:
अथ वृत्रस्य कौरव्य शरीरादभिनिःसृता ।
ब्रह्महत्या महाघोरा रौद्रा लोकभयावहा ॥

meaning.en: Then from Vritra's body, Kaurava, came out the terrible Brahmin-killing, dreadful, fearful, frightening to the worlds.

verses.text:
करालदशना भीमा विकृता कृष्णपिङ्गला ।
प्रकीर्णमूर्धजा चैव घोरनेत्रा च भारत ॥

meaning.en: With fearsome teeth, horrible, deformed, black and tawny, with scattered hair and terrible eyes, Bharata,

verses.text:
कपालमालिनी चैव कृशा च भरतर्षभ ।
रुधिरार्द्रा च धर्मज्ञ चीरवस्त्रनिवासिनी ॥

meaning.en: wearing a garland of skulls, thin, best of Bharatas, wet with blood, knower of dharma, and clad in clothes of bark.

verses.text:
साभिनिष्क्रम्य राजेन्द्र तादृग्रूपा भयावहा ।
वज्रिणं मृगयामास तदा भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Coming out, king, in that fearsome form, she then looked for the wielder of the thunderbolt, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वृत्रहा कुरुनन्दन ।
स्वर्गायाभिमुखः प्रायाल्लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥

meaning.en: After some time, joy of the Kurus, the killer of Vritra set out toward heaven, wishing the good of the worlds.

verses.text:
बिसान्निःसरमाणं तु दृष्ट्वा शक्रं महौजसम् ।
कण्ठे जग्राह देवेन्द्रं सुलग्ना चाभवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the very mighty Shakra coming out of a lotus stalk, she seized the lord of the gods by the neck and clung to him then.

verses.text:
स हि तस्मिन्समुत्पन्ने ब्रह्महत्याकृते भये ।
नलिन्यां बिसमध्यस्थो बभूवाब्दगणान्बहून् ॥

meaning.en: When the fear caused by Brahmin-killing arose, he stayed for many years in the middle of a lotus stalk in a lotus pond.

verses.text:
अनुसृत्य तु यत्नात्स तया वै ब्रह्महत्यया ।
तदा गृहीतः कौरव्य निश्चेष्टः समपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: But she followed him with effort, and then, seized by that Brahmin-killing, Kaurava, he became motionless.

verses.text:
तस्या व्यपोहने शक्रः परं यत्नं चकार ह ।
न चाशकत्तां देवेन्द्रो ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Shakra made great effort to shake her off, but the lord of the gods could not drive away Brahmin-killing.

verses.text:
गृहीत एव तु तया देवेन्द्रो भरतर्षभ ।
पितामहमुपागम्य शिरसा प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥

meaning.en: Seized by her, the lord of the gods, best of Bharatas, went to the grandfather and honored him with his head.

verses.text:
ज्ञात्वा गृहीतं शक्रं तु द्विजप्रवरहत्यया ।
ब्रह्मा संचिन्तयामास तदा भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Knowing Shakra seized by the killing of the best of the twice-born, Brahma, best of Bharatas, then considered.

verses.text:
तामुवाच महाबाहो ब्रह्महत्यां पितामहः ।
स्वरेण मधुरेणाथ सान्त्वयन्निव भारत ॥

meaning.en: The grandfather spoke to that Brahmin-killing, mighty-armed one, with a sweet voice, as if soothing her, Bharata.

verses.text:
मुच्यतां त्रिदशेन्द्रोऽयं मत्प्रियं कुरु भामिनि ।
ब्रूहि किं ते करोम्यद्य कामं कं त्वमिहेच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "Let this lord of the thirty gods be freed; do what pleases me, lady. Say what I may do for you today, and what wish you want here."

verses.text: ब्रह्महत्योवाच

meaning.en: The Brahmin-killing said:

verses.text:
त्रिलोकपूजिते देवे प्रीते त्रैलोक्यकर्तरि ।
कृतमेवेह मन्येऽहं निवासं तु विधत्स्व मे ॥

meaning.en: "When the god worshipped by the three worlds, maker of the three worlds, is pleased, I think it is done here; but arrange a dwelling for me.

verses.text:
त्वया कृतेयं मर्यादा लोकसंरक्षणार्थिना ।
स्थापना वै सुमहती त्वया देव प्रवर्तिता ॥

meaning.en: This limit was made by you, wishing to protect the worlds; a very great establishment was set going by you, god.

verses.text:
प्रीते तु त्वयि धर्मज्ञ सर्वलोकेश्वरे प्रभो ।
शक्रादपगमिष्यामि निवासं तु विधत्स्व मे ॥

meaning.en: When you, knower of dharma, lord of all worlds, are pleased, I will leave Shakra; but arrange a dwelling for me."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
तथेति तां प्राह तदा ब्रह्महत्यां पितामहः ।
उपायतः स शक्रस्य ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहत ॥

meaning.en: "So be it," the grandfather said to Brahmin-killing, and by a device he removed Brahmin-killing from Shakra.

verses.text:
ततः स्वयंभुवा ध्यातस्तत्र वह्निर्महात्मना ।
ब्रह्माणमुपसंगम्य ततो वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Fire, thought of there by the great self-born one, approached Brahma and spoke these words.

verses.text:
प्राप्तोऽस्मि भगवन्देव त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम ।
यत्कर्तव्यं मया देव तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: "I have come to you, blessed god, scorcher of foes. What I must do, god, you should tell."

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
बहुधा विभजिष्यामि ब्रह्महत्यामिमामहम् ।
शक्रस्याद्य विमोक्षार्थं चतुर्भागं प्रतीच्छ मे ॥

meaning.en: "I will divide this Brahmin-killing in many ways. For Shakra's release today, accept a fourth part from me."

verses.text: अग्निरुवाच

meaning.en: Fire said:

verses.text:
मम मोक्षस्य कोऽन्तो वै ब्रह्मन्ध्यायस्व वै प्रभो ।
एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं तत्त्वतो लोकपूजित ॥

meaning.en: "What is the end of my release, Brahma? Think, lord. This I wish to know truly, you who are worshipped by the worlds."

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
यस्त्वां ज्वलन्तमासाद्य स्वयं वै मानवः क्वचित् ।
बीजौषधिरसैर्वह्ने न यक्ष्यति तमोवृतः ॥

meaning.en: "Whoever, ever, a man, covered in darkness, does not himself sacrifice to you as you blaze, Fire, with seeds, herbs and juices,

verses.text:
तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं तत्रैव च निवत्स्यति ।
ब्रह्महत्या हव्यवाह व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः ॥

meaning.en: she will quickly go to him and live right there. Bearer of oblations, let your mental fever go from you."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचो हव्यकव्यभुक् ।
पितामहस्य भगवांस्तथा च तदभूत्प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, the eater of offerings to gods and ancestors accepted the grandfather's words, and so it came to be, lord.

verses.text:
ततो वृक्षौषधितृणं समाहूय पितामहः ।
इममर्थं महाराज वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे ॥

meaning.en: Then the grandfather called the trees, herbs and grasses, and began to say this to them, great king.

verses.text:
ततो वृक्षौषधितृणं तथैवोक्तं यथातथम् ।
व्यथितं वह्निवद्राजन्ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then trees, herbs and grasses, told thus truly, distressed like Fire, said this to Brahma.

verses.text:
अस्माकं ब्रह्महत्यातो कोऽन्तो लोकपितामह ।
स्वभावनिहतानस्मान्न पुनर्हन्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "What is the end of our Brahmin-killing, grandfather of the world? You should not kill us again, who are already struck down by our nature.

verses.text:
वयमग्निं तथा शीतं वर्षं च पवनेरितम् ।
सहामः सततं देव तथा छेदनभेदनम् ॥

meaning.en: We always bear fire, cold, rain driven by wind, and cutting and splitting, god.

verses.text:
ब्रह्महत्यामिमामद्य भवतः शासनाद्वयम् ।
ग्रहीष्यामस्त्रिलोकेश मोक्षं चिन्तयतां भवान् ॥

meaning.en: By your command we will take this Brahmin-killing today, lord of the three worlds; think of our release."

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
पर्वकाले तु संप्राप्ते यो वै छेदनभेदनम् ।
करिष्यति नरो मोहात्तमेषानुगमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "When the festival time comes, the man who through delusion cuts or splits you, she will follow him."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततो वृक्षौषधितृणमेवमुक्तं महात्मना ।
ब्रह्माणमभिसंपूज्य जगामाशु यथागतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the trees, herbs and grasses, so addressed by the great one, honored Brahma and quickly went as they had come.

verses.text:
आहूयाप्सरसो देवस्ततो लोकपितामहः ।
वाचा मधुरया प्राह सान्त्वयन्निव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then the god, grandfather of the worlds, called the apsarases and spoke to them with sweet speech, as if soothing them, Bharata.

verses.text:
इयमिन्द्रादनुप्राप्ता ब्रह्महत्या वराङ्गनाः ।
चतुर्थमस्या भागं हि मयोक्ताः संप्रतीच्छत ॥

meaning.en: "This Brahmin-killing, fair ones, has come from Indra. I tell you, accept a fourth part of her."

verses.text: अप्सरस ऊचुः

meaning.en: The apsarases said:

verses.text:
ग्रहणे कृतबुद्धीनां देवेश तव शासनात् ।
मोक्षं समयतोऽस्माकं चिन्तयस्व पितामह ॥

meaning.en: "Lord of the gods, by your command we are resolved to take it; but, grandfather, think of our release, by agreement."

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
रजस्वलासु नारीषु यो वै मैथुनमाचरेत् ।
तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं व्येतु वो मानसो ज्वरः ॥

meaning.en: "Whoever has intercourse with women in their monthly period, she will quickly go to him. Let your mental fever go."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
तथेति हृष्टमनस उक्त्वाथाप्सरसां गणाः ।
स्वानि स्थानानि संप्राप्य रेमिरे भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," the troops of apsarases, glad at heart, reached their own places and sported, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
ततस्त्रिलोककृद्देवः पुनरेव महातपाः ।
अपः संचिन्तयामास ध्यातास्ताश्चाप्यथागमन् ॥

meaning.en: Then the god, maker of the three worlds, of great austerity, thought of the waters again, and being thought of, they came.

verses.text:
तास्तु सर्वाः समागम्य ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् ।
इदमूचुर्वचो राजन्प्रणिपत्य पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: All of them, having come to Brahma of boundless radiance and bowed to the grandfather, said these words, king.

verses.text:
इमाः स्म देव संप्राप्तास्त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम ।
शासनात्तव देवेश समाज्ञापय नो विभो ॥

meaning.en: "We have come to you, god, scorcher of foes; by your command, lord of gods, give us orders, lord."

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
इयं वृत्रादनुप्राप्ता पुरुहूतं महाभया ।
ब्रह्महत्या चतुर्थांशमस्या यूयं प्रतीच्छत ॥

meaning.en: "This very fearful Brahmin-killing has come from Vritra to Purandara. Accept a fourth part of her."

verses.text: आप ऊचुः

meaning.en: The waters said:

verses.text:
एवं भवतु लोकेश यथा वदसि नः प्रभो ।
मोक्षं समयतोऽस्माकं संचिन्तयितुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "So be it, lord of the worlds, as you say to us; but you should think of our release by agreement.

verses.text:
त्वं हि देवेश सर्वस्य जगतः परमो गुरुः ।
कोऽन्यः प्रसादो हि भवेद्यः कृच्छ्रान्नः समुद्धरेत् ॥

meaning.en: You are, lord of gods, the supreme teacher of the whole world; what other grace could lift us from hardship?"

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
अल्पा इति मतिं कृत्वा यो नरो बुद्धिमोहितः ।
श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषाणि युष्मासु प्रतिमोक्ष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever man, bewildered in mind, thinking you small, discharges phlegm, urine and excrement into you,

verses.text:
तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं तत्रैव च निवत्स्यति ।
तथा वो भविता मोक्ष इति सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥

meaning.en: she will quickly go to him and live right there. So will your release be; I tell you truly."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततो विमुच्य देवेन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्या युधिष्ठिर ।
यथानिसृष्टं तं देशमगच्छद्देवशासनात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, Yudhishthira, Brahmin-killing, releasing the lord of the gods, went to the place assigned, by the gods' order.

verses.text:
एवं शक्रेण संप्राप्ता ब्रह्महत्या जनाधिप ।
पितामहमनुज्ञाप्य सोऽश्वमेधमकल्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: So, lord of men, Shakra received Brahmin-killing; and, with the grandfather's permission, he arranged the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
श्रूयते हि महाराज संप्राप्ता वासवेन वै ।
ब्रह्महत्या ततः शुद्धिं हयमेधेन लब्धवान् ॥

meaning.en: We hear, great king, that Vasava, having incurred Brahmin-killing, gained purification by the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
समवाप्य श्रियं देवो हत्वारींश्च सहस्रशः ।
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे वासवः पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: Having regained his glory and killed thousands of enemies, the god Vasava, lord of the earth, felt incomparable joy.

verses.text:
वृत्रस्य रुधिराच्चैव खुखुण्डाः पार्थ जज्ञिरे ।
द्विजातिभिरभक्ष्यास्ते दीक्षितैश्च तपोधनैः ॥

meaning.en: From Vritra's blood, Partha, arose the khukhundas; they are not to be eaten by the twice-born or by ascetics who have been consecrated.

verses.text:
सर्वावस्थं त्वमप्येषां द्विजातीनां प्रियं कुरु ।
इमे हि भूतले देवाः प्रथिताः कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: You too, in every condition, should do what pleases these twice-born; for these gods are famed on earth, joy of the Kurus.

verses.text:
एवं शक्रेण कौरव्य बुद्धिसौक्ष्म्यान्महासुरः ।
उपायपूर्वं निहतो वृत्रोऽथामिततेजसा ॥

meaning.en: So by Shakra, Kaurava, through subtle intelligence, the great asura Vritra, of boundless radiance, was killed by a device.

verses.text:
एवं त्वमपि कौरव्य पृथिव्यामपराजितः ।
भविष्यसि यथा देवः शतक्रतुरमित्रहा ॥

meaning.en: So you too, Kaurava, will be unconquered on earth, like the god Shatakratu, slayer of foes.

verses.text:
ये तु शक्रकथां दिव्यामिमां पर्वसु पर्वसु ।
विप्रमध्ये पठिष्यन्ति न ते प्राप्स्यन्ति किल्बिषम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who read this divine tale of Shakra at every festival among brahmins will gain no sin.

verses.text:
इत्येतद्वृत्रमाश्रित्य शक्रस्यात्यद्भुतं महत् ।
कथितं कर्म ते तात किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: Thus this great and most wonderful deed of Shakra concerning Vritra has been told to you, dear son; what more do you wish to hear?
